notes.title: Lost in memory update 2.4
notes.content:
[b]I was informed of a big bug in lost in memory where you can go through walls by pausing the game so I fixed that and use this as an opportunity to fix other things I'm more confident in dealing with now.[/b]

[u]-Fixed the wall pausing bug.-[/u]

[u]-Fixed directional idling animation with controller input with joystick.-[/u]

[u]-Changed the games text font to something more appropriate.-[/u]

[u]-Switching out memories will now automatically close the pause menu for you.-[/u]

[u]-Improved the animation for using the scalpel memory, the maid memory and switching memories.-[/u]

[u]-And some smaller fixes-[/u]

notes.title: Lost in memory update V2.1
notes.content:
-Updated controller controls so that "A" is interact instead of "X" for better control feel.
-"X" is now the memory Using button.
-Fixed the bug were if you pause the game well a text box is open the game soft locks.

notes.title: Lost in memory UPDATE Ver2.0 Flesh and mind is out now!
notes.content:
Lost in memory UPDATE Ver2.0 Flesh and mind 
This update includes

[u]-Three new endings.[/u]
   The guilt ending.
   The Shut in ending.
   The killer ending.
[u]-New areas to explore.[/u]
    bunny area.
    rose area.
    Mars planet.
    An expansion to the reflection area.
    Forest secret area. 
    City secret area. 
    Inverted mansion.
    Space secret area. 
[u]-The world will now change depending on how many memories collected.[/u]
[u]-More interactions with characters.[/u]
[u]-New collectibles to find.[/u]
[u]-New secrets around the world.[/u]
[u]-New abilities to use.[/u]
   The scalpel memory can be used to attack.
[u]-Controller support improved[/u]
   moved some buttons for convenience.
   Add D-pad for movement.
[u]-Some memories have been moved.[/u]
[u]-And various bug fixes.[/u]
